about.title: About {{businessName}}
about.content: We serve technology companies operating from Paraguay — from 2-person SaaS startups to 50+ headcount software houses. We leverage Paraguay's territorial tax system (10% local / 0% foreign) to minimize tax burden legally, handle stock options accounting, payroll for distributed teams, and bilingual reporting for international investors.

faq.q: Do you understand Paraguay's territorial tax system?
faq.a: Yes. It's core to what we do. Service exports from PY are foreign-source income and qualify for 0% IRE. We document the substantiation correctly for DNIT.

faq.q: Can you handle our US C-corp + PY subsidiary structure?
faq.a: Yes. This is the most common pattern for PY-founded startups. We coordinate with your US tax advisor and handle the PY side end-to-end.

faq.q: Do you integrate with our stack (Stripe, QuickBooks, Carta)?
faq.a: Yes. Read-only API access is standard. We can also pull data from Gusto/Deel (payroll), AngelList, Carta (cap table), and major SaaS billing platforms.

faq.q: How do you handle stock options for PY employees?
faq.a: Common pattern: Delaware C-corp issues options, PY employees exercise under PY tax rules. Gain at exercise is taxable as IRP in PY. We document grant, vesting, and exercise correctly.
Yes — our team operates bilingually. Monthly reports, tax filings, board updates can all be delivered in English.

faq.q: What if we raise and need audited financials?
faq.a: We deliver audit-ready books from day 1. When audit is required (usually Series A+), we coordinate with Big 4 or boutique firms — our books pass.

faq.q: How do you handle remote contractors across LATAM?
faq.a: We advise on whether each arrangement is contractor vs employee in each country (AR, BR, CO, UY, MX). We coordinate with local providers (Deel, Ontop) for payment and compliance.
